files.changelog.d/SOFT-2883-ctrl-t-folder.md: The folder list for a new tab keeps your highlight on the folder you chose while the list refreshes.
files.changelog.d/SOFT-3055-session-commands.m: Chats on a server can start, restart and manage other Multibot chats from the command line without a layout key.
files.changelog.d/SOFT-3071-chat-exit-report.m: Server chat exits now record why each chat stopped, so frequent stops can be traced and fixed.
files.changelog.d/SOFT-3075-pick-repo-layout.m:
Rows in the new-tab folder picker lead with the folder name, so a long path no longer hides which folder you are choosing.
The server name stays fully readable and row text no longer runs under the scrollbar.
files.changelog.d/SOFT-3077-chat-stays-put.md: The chat no longer hides its last line or shifts when a new message arrives while you are reading.
